notes: Three separate rate cards found: Rack (non-resident, public/full rate), Contract (Sunworld Agent rate, non-resident, discounted from Rack), Resident (KES, 15% agent commission stated).
Rack card uses 3 season columns (Mid: 1 Jan-31 Mar & 1 Oct-20 Dec; Green: 1 Apr-30 Jun; High: 1 Jul-30 Sep & 21 Dec-2 Jan).

Contract card uses 4 season columns that don't cleanly map to the Rack card's 3 - it splits '1 Oct-20 Dec 2026' out as its own column distinct from the Jan-Mar Mid-season figure (120 vs 130 for Full Board Mtito Luxury), whereas Rack treats Jan-Mar and Oct-Dec as one combined Mid-season figure (170). [Unverified] whether this 4-way split is intentional or a document layout artifact - the source PDF's header row is visually garbled (superscript ordinals split across lines) making the season boundaries hard to fully disambiguate; figures themselves were read directly off the table cells.

ANOMALY: Contract card's Ground Package 'Single room supplement' 4th column reads 250 - wildly inconsistent with the 85/85/85 figures in the other three columns for the same row, and suspiciously identical to the Full Board High-season base rate (190) +... no clean relationship either. Very likely a table-extraction misalignment in the source PDF. Flagged, not used as verified.

ANOMALY: Resident Rates card labels its park fee line 'Masai Mara Park fees' (Adult KSH1,500, Children KSH500) despite Mtito Safari Camp being in Tsavo, not the Maasai Mara - and the amount is far too low to be an actual Maasai Mara Reserve fee (~KSH13,000-26,000 equivalent). This reads as a copy-paste/template labeling error in the source document, not a genuine Maasai Mara fee. The correct fee (likely a Tsavo/KWS park fee) is not independently confirmed anywhere in this folder.
